### 1. Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Biotech]** **[GenBio AI launches virtual cell model AIDO Cell](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/18/david-baker-genbio-ai-new-virtual-model-unveiled-aido-cell/)** — *STAT*
  * GenBio AI, co-founded by Nobel laureate David Baker, rolled out AIDO Cell, a virtual cell AI model designed to simulate complex cellular mechanisms.
  * The tool aims to model biological interactions in silico to accelerate preclinical target discovery and drug design.

* **[Investigation raises technical concerns in Alzheimer's genetics research](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/more-alzheimer-s-research-trouble)** — *Science*
  * An investigation highlights potential data integrity and methodological issues in high-profile studies examining protective and disease-linked genetic mutations in Alzheimer's disease.
  * The report focuses on family lineage data previously analyzed to understand protective mechanisms that lower amyloid or neurodegenerative pathology.

* **[PanoraOnc AI model enables cross-cancer outcome prediction](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.17.26354679)** — *medRxiv*
  * Pretrained on clinico-genomic and imaging data from 84,131 patients across 66 cancer types, the PanoraOnc AI model achieved zero- and few-shot prediction of treatment responses in unseen clinical cohorts.
  * The pan-cancer model outperformed traditional statistical and specialized machine learning baselines across diverse treatment modalities.

* **[Genomic-Adjusted Radiation Dose prognostic in rectal cancer](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.14.26360478)** — *medRxiv*
  * A pooled retrospective analysis of 497 locally advanced rectal cancer patients across four trials (including TIMING, OPRA, and CAO/ARO/AIO-94) evaluated the Radiosensitivity Index-derived Genomic-Adjusted Radiation Dose (GARD).
  * Achieving a GARD score ≥ 21 was associated with a statistically significant restricted mean survival time gain of 2.60 months at 60 months (HR = 0.964 per 5-node/dose increment).

* **[Oncolytic drug delivery via repurposed Trojan mast cells](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42613295/)** — *PubMed*
  * Researchers developed a platform that repurposes mast cell biology to act as targeted delivery vehicles for oncolytic agents, exploiting allergic pathway homing mechanisms.

* **[SIK2/3 inhibition suppresses inflammatory expression in psoriasis models](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42612789/)** — *PubMed*
  * Small-molecule inhibition of Salt-Inducible Kinases 2 and 3 (SIK2/3) reduced key pro-inflammatory cytokine signatures in preclinical models of psoriasis.

* **[Shift in immunology pipeline strategy toward mechanism stacking](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2089718967761871056)** — *X / @andrewpannu*
  * Immunology drug development is evolving beyond single-pathway biologics (TNF, IL-12/23, IL-17, IL-4/13) and single oral modulators (JAK, S1P, TYK2, oral IL-23).
  * Biopharma portfolios are increasingly building multi-mechanism stacks across modalities — including targeted protein degraders, bispecifics, T-cell engagers, and CAR-T therapies — to hedge biological risk and replace aging franchise assets.

---

### 2. Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **[Experts review study design choices following fatal Duchenne trial](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/19/huidagene-clinical-trial-deaths-experts-dissect-study-design/)** — *STAT*
  * Gene-editing experts questioned the clinical trial parameters used by Huidagene in a Phase 1/2 trial for Duchenne muscular dystrophy following the death of a pediatric participant.
  * Scrutiny focused on the high viral vector dosing and specific gene-editing delivery modifications that had previously been scaled back by Western developers due to safety risks.

* **[Biotech]** **[Danburstotug active in relapsed/refractory extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42613033/)** — *PubMed*
  * Phase 2 results from the DISTINKT trial evaluating danburstotug, an anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody, demonstrated therapeutic response and manageable safety in patients with relapsed/refractory extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma.

* **[iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte injections tested in ischemic heart failure](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04605-1)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * An early-stage randomized clinical trial established the preliminary feasibility and safety profile of intramyocardial injections of allogeneic human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs) in patients with severe ischemic heart failure.

* **[Dronabinol reduces PTSD-related nightmares in early clinical trial](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04586-1)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Clinical data evaluate dronabinol (pharmaceutical Δ⁹-tetrahydrocannabinol) for suppressing trauma-related nightmares in post-traumatic stress disorder, showing efficacy signals while calling for larger confirmatory studies.

---

### 3. Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Biotech]** **[Merck and Moderna mRNA cancer vaccine hits Phase 3 endpoint in melanoma](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/19/mrna-cancer-vaccine-trial-melanoma-merck-moderna/)** — *STAT* / *[X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2090028389331509703)*
  * Moderna and Merck announced that their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine (mRNA-4157/V940 / intismeran autogene) combined with Keytruda (pembrolizumab) met its primary endpoints in the Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial for high-risk stage III/IV and completely resected Stage IIB–IV melanoma.
  * The combination demonstrated statistically significant improvements in recurrence-free survival (RFS) and distant metastasis-free survival (DMFS) compared to Keytruda monotherapy.

* **[Biotech]** **[Amylyx GLP-1 antagonist avexitide reduces post-bariatric hypoglycemia in Phase 3](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/amylyx-glp1-avexitide-clinical-trial-results-blood-sugar/828099/)** — *BioPharm Dive*
  * Amylyx Pharmaceuticals announced its Phase 3 trial of avexitide achieved its primary endpoint, showing a 55% reduction in severe hypoglycemic events versus placebo in post-bariatric surgery patients.
  * Adverse events were predominantly mild-to-moderate gastrointestinal effects or injection-site reactions; Amylyx plans an NDA submission before the end of the year.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca and Hutchmed Tagrisso combo extends survival in MET-driven NSCLC](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/astrazeneca-sandoz-china-bristol-myers-maplight/828058/)** — *BioPharm Dive*
  * A combination of Tagrisso (osimertinib) and Orpathys (savolitinib) significantly delayed disease progression and extended overall survival compared to chemotherapy in EGFR-mutated, MET-driven non-small cell lung cancer patients whose disease progressed on prior Tagrisso.

* **[Biotech]** **[EyePoint Pharmaceuticals Phase 3 blindness candidate misses primary endpoint](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/18/eyepoint-blindness-treatment-setback-amylyx-avexitide-win/)** — *STAT*
  * EyePoint Pharmaceuticals reported that its Phase 3 trial evaluating an investigational treatment for age-related macular degeneration failed to hit its primary visual acuity endpoint.

---

### 4. Regulatory & Approvals

* **[FDA issues discussion paper on generative AI-enabled medical devices](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-seeks-public-feedback-inform-regulatory-approach-generative-ai-enabled-medical-devices)** — *FDA News*
  * The FDA released a comprehensive discussion paper soliciting public feedback on premarket requirements, lifecycle risk controls, and postmarket surveillance for generative AI devices.
  * The agency aims to build a flexible regulatory framework to accelerate safe deployment of complex AI models in clinical workflows.

* **[Heidi Overton anticipated as Trump administration FDA Commissioner nominee](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/18/heidi-overton-fda-commissioner-nominee-white-house-adviser/)** — *STAT*
  * White House health policy adviser Dr. Heidi Overton is expected to be formally nominated to lead the FDA as Commissioner.

* **[FDA launches "Prescribe with Confidence" campaign for opioid use disorder](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/prescribe-confidence/partner-us-help-more-providers-prescribe-confidence)** — *FDA News*
  * FDA’s CDER initiated an educational initiative aimed at expanding primary care identification of opioid use disorder (OUD) and increasing outpatient prescribing of evidence-based medications for OUD (MOUD).

* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA updates novel drug approvals with three new approvals](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/novel-drug-approvals-fda/novel-drug-approvals-2026)** — *FDA*
  * **Tauklarify (florquinitau F 18):** Approved August 13, 2026, for PET imaging of brain tau neurofibrillary tangle pathology in adults with cognitive impairment evaluated for Alzheimer's disease.
  * **Zenbexus (iberdomide):** Approved August 13, 2026, in combination with daratumumab, hyaluronidase-fihj, and dexamethasone for adults with multiple myeloma who have received at least one prior line of therapy (including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent).
  * **Orzeyful (oveporexton):** Approved August 5, 2026, for the treatment of narcolepsy type 1.

* **[Biotech]** **[Pliant Therapeutics receives FDA Fast Track designation for PLN-101095](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2089695466007003241)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  * Fast Track status granted for PLN-101095 in combination with pembrolizumab for the treatment of immune checkpoint inhibitor-refractory solid tumors.

* **[FDA warns against tainted OTC weight-loss supplements](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/medication-health-fraud-notifications/esbelta-intense-loss-may-be-harmful-due-hidden-ingredients)** — *FDA*
  * Laboratory testing revealed Esbelta Intense Loss contains unlisted sibutramine, desmethylsibutramine, benzylsibutramine, and sildenafil, posing cardiovascular and interaction risks.
  * Testing of Esbelta Chupapanza Flat Belly confirmed unlisted phenolphthalein, an unapproved substance associated with potential carcinogenicity.

* **[FDA issues CGMP warning letters to multiple manufacturing facilities and contract lab](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/eugia-pharma-specialities-limited-730469-08132026)** — *FDA*
  * Warning letters citing significant finished pharmaceutical CGMP violations were issued to Eugia Pharma Specialities, K.C. Pharmaceuticals, Suretec Innovations, Safrel Pharmaceuticals, and contract testing laboratory Auriga Research.

* **[FDA sets FY 2027 PDUFA user fee rates and payment deadline](http://www.fda.gov/industry/fda-user-fee-programs/prescription-drug-user-fee-amendments)** — *FDA*
  * Program fee invoices for FY 2027 were emailed August 18, 2026, with full payments due by October 1, 2026.

---

### 5. Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **[BioMarin acquires Alesta Therapeutics for $275M upfront](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/biomarin-alesta-deal-acquisition-rare-disease-muscle-skeleton/828133/)** — *BioPharm Dive*
  * BioMarin acquired privately held Alesta Therapeutics for $275 million upfront and up to $215 million in potential milestone payments.
  * The acquisition adds ALE1, a Phase 1/2 clinical candidate for hypophosphatasia, to BioMarin's rare skeletal and muscle disease pipeline.

* **[Biotech]** **[Leo Pharma acquires rights to FDA-submitted skin disease drug for $435M](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/leo-pharma-buys-late-stage-skin-disease-drug-435m-deal/828150/)** — *BioPharm Dive*
  * Leo Pharma acquired commercial rights to dersimelagon in a deal valued at up to $435 million in upfront and near-term milestones plus royalties.
  * Dersimelagon is currently under FDA review as an oral treatment for erythropoietic protoporphyria and X-linked protoporphyria.

* **[Biotech]** **[IDEAYA Biosciences enters clinical collaboration with Genentech](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2090016407719129262)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  * Formed a clinical trial collaboration to evaluate combination strategies in MTAP-deleted, KRAS G12D-mutant pancreatic cancer.

* **[Biotech]** **[Amylyx Pharmaceuticals launches $350 million public offering](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2089804971080302717)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  * Proposed a $350 million offering of common stock to fund ongoing clinical and pipeline activities.

* **[Biotech]** **[FRNM files resale registration statement for up to 75 million shares](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2089833580432183655)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  * Registered up to 75 million common shares for potential resale by existing PIPE and SPAC investors.

---

### 6. Public Health & Policy

* **[Former NIAID adviser David Morens pleads guilty in federal court](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/18/david-morens-guilty-plea-niaid-fauci-adviser/)** — *STAT*
  * Former senior NIAID adviser David Morens pleaded guilty to charges of conspiring to defraud the government and deliberately evading Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) public records requests regarding agency business and commercial relationships.

* **[Global neurosurgical study reveals stark TBI mortality disparities across 29 countries](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04600-6)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Findings from the Global Neurosurgical Study-1 (GNS-I) across 100 hospitals showed that traumatic brain injury outcomes and mortality rates vary dramatically based on national Human Development Index (HDI) tiers.

* **[U.S. kindergarten vaccine exemption rates continue to rise](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/18/health-news-kindergarten-vaccine-exemptions-are-climbing/)** — *STAT*
  * Public health surveillance reports an ongoing national increase in non-medical vaccine exemptions among children entering kindergarten.

* **[DHS sued over proposed visa duration caps for foreign postdocs and students](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/18/dhs-sued-over-visa-time-limit-for-foreign-students/)** — *STAT*
  * Higher education and research organizations filed suit against the Department of Homeland Security over proposed visa tenure limits affecting foreign graduate students and post-doctoral academic researchers.

* **[Physicians group sues HHS and USDA over dietary guidelines panel](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/19/physician-group-sues-trump-administration-over-dietary-guidelines-food-pyramid-hhs-usda/)** — *STAT*
  * A lawsuit filed by a plant-based advocacy organization alleges HHS and USDA relied on an undisclosed advisory panel to alter federal dietary guidelines and food pyramid structures in violation of administrative transparency laws.

* **[Public health accrediting body evaluates structural racism curriculum rules](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/19/public-health-education-accrediting-body-ceph-walks-dei-tightrope/)** — *STAT*
  * The Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH) is considering proposals to strip mandatory language requiring accredited schools to explicitly teach structural racism and systemic bias.

* **[FDA outlines OTC topical antiseptic monograph confidentiality rules](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/over-counter-otc-nonprescription-drugs/topical-antiseptic-drug-products)** — *FDA*
  * Clarified that under the OTC Monograph Safety, Innovation, and Reform Act (OMSIA) established by the CARES Act, sponsor submissions for OTC monograph order proceedings are kept confidential until the issuance of a final order.

---

**Worth watching:** Readout of full INTerpath-001 subgroup data for intismeran autogene plus Keytruda in resected Stage IIB–IV melanoma to gauge the magnitude of benefit in earlier-stage surgical adjuvant settings.
